Interpretable signal: an implementation-layer finding (MECH-313 inert without SP-CEM), not ARC-065 evidence. learning_extracted: A matched control needs a precondition gate on the matched quantity; a zero-entropy 'matched' control should have been precondition_unmet, not PASS.
A noise lever acting on selection over a single-class pool is inert by construction; inject control noise downstream of candidate generation.
Entropy over arms with ~10x different survival is not comparable; normalise per step window or match survival.

live_hypotheses: H1-structured: the full ARC-065 stack produces selected-action diversity with structure (context-dependence) beyond entropy-matched unstructured noise
H2-entropy-equivalent: ALL_ON diversity is indistinguishable from unstructured noise at matched entropy
H3-survival-artefact: ALL_ON diversity is an artefact of short harm-terminated episodes (early-episode thrash)

suggested_probes.sketch: structure readout at matched entropy: mutual information between selected action class and local context (hazard/resource field bins) for ALL_ON vs a noise control injected at FINAL selection, with a precondition gate |H_noise - H_ALL_ON| <= 0.15 nats else precondition_unmet. Null: MI(ALL_ON) - MI(noise) <= 0.

noise control = SP-CEM ON with structured channels (MECH-341, V_s, MECH-314) OFF and temperature tuned per seed to match ALL_ON entropy; tests whether the proposer alone plus noise reproduces ALL_ON behaviour. Null: behavioural readouts (harm, resource rate, MI) not different from ALL_ON.

survival-matched measurement: compute entropy over the first N steps of every episode (N = min survival across arms) or in a harm-free reef variant; null: ALL_ON entropy advantage vanishes under survival matching.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-09-24 D2 cluster autopsy (failure_autopsy_gflag0452-D2-cluster_2026-09-24, GFLAG-0452, staging): V3-EXQ-171 / V3-EXQ-184 (x2 manifests) / V3-EXQ-308 PASSes do not isolate the MECH-033 mechanism. The ablation arm (ABLATED / NO_CHAIN) is uniform random action (drivers :342 / :346 / :529), which removes the trained HarmHead AND the planner, not only E2-kernel seeding; any harm-aware selector would beat it. The random arm is a fixed property of env+seed, independent of every trained module: seed 42 = 0.061516023781776445 harm_rate / 4179 events, bit-identical in 171 / 184-0401 / 184-0404 and equal to within 1e-16 in 308 (seeds 7/13 likewise across 184 x2 and 308), so the four 'supports' share one comparator. There is no hippocampal module (inline Linear encoders), and the k=3 'chain' is one action followed by two forced STAY steps, i.e. a one-action lookahead with persistence, not a seeded multi-step rollout. The claim's own manipulation spec ('ablate the E2-kernel-to-hippocampal handoff while leaving rollouts and E3 scoring otherwise intact') is the opposite of what these runs did. Direction: non_contributory (171, 184-0401, 308); 184-0404 is a same-design same-seed duplicate -> superseded. The only MECH-033 run with a real HippocampalModule and a matched-budget non-random comparator is V3-EXQ-055 (AO_CHAIN vs SELF_CHAIN); 055 is a single seed (driver --seed default=0) and its SELF_CHAIN comparator sits near random (harm 0.0684 = 91% of RANDOM 0.0754; cal_gap_self 0.021 below 055's own C4 floor 0.03), so even 055 is a weak discrimination. The 'measured four times' / 'fired four times' wording in what_would_answer, and the 'replicated 4x PASS' reading carried by the live_status source (failure_autopsy_grandfathered-r5-batch01-mixed-findings_2026-08-08), are inaccurate and should be corrected. A discriminating portfolio (k=0 HarmHead-greedy, E2-scrambled, k=1 vs k=3 non-STAY continuation, E2-seeded vs random-seeded hippocampal rollout) is owed. 171 is the 2-seed (42,123) predecessor; its duplicate manifest 20260330T070404Z is already superseded (precedent for the 184 disposition).

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: measurement_test_design_defect (ablation confound: random-action comparator removes HarmHead + planner, not only E2 seeding). No substrate ceiling asserted; standard is the behaviour-preserving mapping.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-09-24 D2 cluster autopsy (failure_autopsy_gflag0452-D2-cluster_2026-09-24, GFLAG-0452, staging): V3-EXQ-171 / V3-EXQ-184 (x2 manifests) / V3-EXQ-308 PASSes do not isolate the MECH-033 mechanism. The ablation arm (ABLATED / NO_CHAIN) is uniform random action (drivers :342 / :346 / :529), which removes the trained HarmHead AND the planner, not only E2-kernel seeding; any harm-aware selector would beat it. The random arm is a fixed property of env+seed, independent of every trained module: seed 42 = 0.061516023781776445 harm_rate / 4179 events, bit-identical in 171 / 184-0401 / 184-0404 and equal to within 1e-16 in 308 (seeds 7/13 likewise across 184 x2 and 308), so the four 'supports' share one comparator. There is no hippocampal module (inline Linear encoders), and the k=3 'chain' is one action followed by two forced STAY steps, i.e. a one-action lookahead with persistence, not a seeded multi-step rollout. The claim's own manipulation spec ('ablate the E2-kernel-to-hippocampal handoff while leaving rollouts and E3 scoring otherwise intact') is the opposite of what these runs did. Direction: non_contributory (171, 184-0401, 308); 184-0404 is a same-design same-seed duplicate -> superseded. The only MECH-033 run with a real HippocampalModule and a matched-budget non-random comparator is V3-EXQ-055 (AO_CHAIN vs SELF_CHAIN); 055 is a single seed (driver --seed default=0) and its SELF_CHAIN comparator sits near random (harm 0.0684 = 91% of RANDOM 0.0754; cal_gap_self 0.021 below 055's own C4 floor 0.03), so even 055 is a weak discrimination. The 'measured four times' / 'fired four times' wording in what_would_answer, and the 'replicated 4x PASS' reading carried by the live_status source (failure_autopsy_grandfathered-r5-batch01-mixed-findings_2026-08-08), are inaccurate and should be corrected. A discriminating portfolio (k=0 HarmHead-greedy, E2-scrambled, k=1 vs k=3 non-STAY continuation, E2-seeded vs random-seeded hippocampal rollout) is owed. 308 adds an SD-018 ResourceProximityHead and ReLU encoders but keeps the uniform-random NO_CHAIN arm; its NO_CHAIN harm rates equal 184's to ~1e-16 (0.06151602378177612 vs 0.061516023781776445 at seed 42; 4179/4125/4205 events identical), i.e. the same seeded random baseline.
